Subject: Mutual action plan + exec sponsor alignment for close sprint

Jordan —

Following up from our demo last week. Attaching a working draft of the Mutual Action Plan (ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v3.pdf) and a short EB agenda (EB_agenda_draft.pptx). High level asks:

- Confirm an executive sponsor from Acme who can join the executive briefing (EB) in the final week of the close sprint. Our preferred EB week is June 24–28; proposed EB slot: June 25, 11:00–12:00 PT.
- Confirm the list of attendees for the EB (title + role + decision authority).
- Sign off on the MAP milestones in the attached PDF (milestones, acceptance criteria, success metrics).

If June 25 is tight, please suggest one alternate 60‑minute window that week. Once we lock the EB date/time I’ll send a calendar hold and a concise runbook for the meeting (roles, materials, required pre-reads).

A few open items noted in the MAP where we need Acme input: SOC2 evidence timeline, data residency constraint, and final acceptance criteria for the pilot. See the PDF comments lines 14–21 for the specifics.

Next steps (recommended):
- Jordan: confirm sponsor + preferred EB window by EOD Friday.
- Acme: upload sponsor bio and any governance constraints to the shared Drive link below.
- Rishi/Jonas: prepare 10‑minute ask slide + technical readout.

Thanks — excited to get this locked and move into the final sprint.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0123

Attachments: ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v3.pdf (PDF, 12 pages); EB_agenda_draft.pptx (pptx, 3 slides)

Grace —

Thanks for the notes and the MAP draft. Quick answers from our side:

- Sponsor: CFO Maria Santos is our exec sponsor for procurement and org alignment. Maria is available the week of June 24 but prefers mornings PT. I’ve cc’d her here.
- EB availability: June 26 at 10:30 AM PT would work better than June 25 for Maria. Can Redwood do June 26 10:30–11:30 PT?
- SOC2/data residency: we need to see the SOC2 attestation and a short note on EU data residency options. If you can surface those in the MAP, that will unblock Legal.

I reviewed the milestones — overall they look sensible. I’ll circle back with Maria and our PM to share the attendee list + bios by Wednesday.

Jordan
